title: Enrichment analysis of differentially expressed genes in chronic heart failure.
authors: Fang, Xiaoli; Zeng, Xue; Wang, Miao; Qin, Liuqiong; Tan, Chuanhui; Wu, Jiutao
one_liner_zh: 该文为慢性心衰差异表达基因的转录组富集分析，仅涉及序列统计与湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The study explores the differentially expressed genes in the heart tissue of patients with chronic heart failure (CHF) and normal heart tissue, thus providing information for further research on the pathogenesis of CHF. METHODS: The Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database was used to download the whole transcriptome sequencing results of CHF patients (GSE2656, n=49). Transcriptome sequencing results of 44 normal left ventricular tissues were randomly screened and downloaded using the Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEX) database (n=44). We explored the differentially expressed genes between CHF tissue and normal heart tissue. Gene Ontology (GO) functional enrichment analysis and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) signaling pathway enrichment analysis were performed for differentially expressed genes. Growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) was used as a representative differential gene for serological sample verification by the enzyme linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). RESULTS: A total of 902 differentially expressed genes between CHF and normal heart tissues were screened, including 354 up-regulated genes and 548 down-regulated genes. GO enrichment analysis showed that the differentially expressed genes were significantly enriched in the extracellular and sequence-specific DNA binding domains. KEGG enrichment demonstrated that the differential genes were enriched in neuroactive ligand-receptor interaction, the calcium signaling pathway, vascular smooth muscle contraction, and other signaling pathways. ELISA results showed that the expression level of GHRH in patients with heart failure was significantly higher than that in healthy subjects (P<0.05). CONCLUSIONS: A total of 902 differentially expressed genes were found in CHF tissues compared with normal heart tissues. Signaling pathways such as neuroactive ligand-receptor interaction, the calcium ion signaling pathway, and vascular smooth muscle contraction may be related to the pathogenesis of CHF.
abstract_zh: 背景：本研究探讨慢性心力衰竭（CHF）患者心脏组织与正常心脏组织中差异表达基因，从而为CHF发病机制的进一步研究提供信息。方法：使用基因表达综合（GEO）数据库下载CHF患者的全转录组测序结果（GSE2656，n=49）。利用基因型-组织表达（GTEX）数据库随机筛选并下载44例正常左心室组织的转录组测序结果（n=44）。我们探讨了CHF组织与正常心脏组织之间的差异表达基因。对差异表达基因进行了基因本体论（GO）功能富集分析和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）信号通路富集分析。以生长激素释放激素（GHRH）作为代表性差异基因，通过酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）进行血清学样本验证。结果：共筛选出CHF与正常心脏组织之间的902个差异表达基因，包括354个上调基因和548个下调基因。GO富集分析显示，差异表达基因显著富集于细胞外和序列特异性DNA结合域。KEGG富集表明，差异基因富集于神经活性配体-受体相互作用、钙信号通路、血管平滑肌收缩及其他信号通路。ELISA结果显示，心力衰竭患者中GHRH的表达水平显著高于健康受试者（P<0.05）。结论：与正常心脏组织相比，CHF组织中共发现902个差异表达基因。神经活性配体-受体相互作用、钙离子信号通路和血管平滑肌收缩等信号通路可能与CHF的发病机制相关。
